events.body:
## Context

Security-sweep leftover. `pyproject.toml:36` pins `cffi>=1.17.1,<2`, which nothing imports. From cryptography 46 on, cryptography needs `cffi>=2`, so this stale cap holds the transitive cryptography (via `pyjwt[crypto]` and `atproto`) at **43.0.3** in `uv.lock`, which has open advisories. `aiohttp` is locked at 3.12.9 (pyproject:58, used only in `website/consumers.py`) and `pillow` at 12.1.1 (pyproject:43); both have newer releases with fixes.

## What to do

1. Remove the `cffi` line from `blt-core/pyproject.toml` (or change it to `cffi>=2`).
2. Run `uv lock --upgrade-package cffi --upgrade-package cryptography --upgrade-package aiohttp --upgrade-package pillow`.
3. Keep Pillow below 13 in this PR (12.3.x). Raising the cap is a follow-up after reading the 13.0 notes for ImageFont/ImageDraw API removals (used in `website/utils.py`, `views/issue.py`, `views/project.py`).
4. Check that `bitcash`/`coincurve` (pyproject:96) still resolve.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `uv.lock` has cryptography >= 46, cffi >= 2, aiohttp >= 3.14 and pillow >= 12.3
- [ ] `uv sync --locked` succeeds
- [ ] The full Django test suite passes, including the badge/image views

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-core   # heavy: needs ~3 GB RAM
```
